requirements.evidence: Contract met: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:10 `send(string $title, string $message, array $context = []): void`; no-op on null/empty via `if (empty($url)) return;` (:14-16); `Http::timeout(3)->post($url, ['content' => $text])` (:22); `mb_substr($text, 0, 1800, 'UTF-8')` (:19); key redaction with normalized needles incl. api_key/apikey/api-key and webhook (:72-82); Bearer redaction (:51, :96); recursive nested redaction rendered as JSON (:55-58, :85-112); non-2xx and Throwable both logged at error with URL scrubbed (:24-31). config/logging.php adds `audit` (daily, logs/audit.log, level info, days 90) and stack default `daily`; no discord channel; .env.example and phpunit.xml:267 pin LOG_STACK=daily; services.discord.webhook_url added. Gaps: buildText/formatValue run outside the try (:18), so a non-stringable object in context (`(string) $value` at :69) throws an Error, which breaks the never-throw requirement; json_encode failure (invalid UTF-8) silently becomes an empty string (:58). The existing `daily` channel is not in the diff, so its 14-day/LOG_DAILY_DAYS setting is assumed to come from the framework default.

conventions.evidence: Breaks the core TDD convention ('No production code without a test; everything implemented ships with a test'): the diff adds no test files. Docs are kept in sync, which is good: docs/ops/logging.md is added and CHANGELOG.md:34 is updated under [Unreleased]. The public `send` method has no PHPDoc, and docs/ops/logging.md has no newline at end of file.

security.evidence: Secrets are redacted by key (case-insensitive, with - and space normalized to _) and by Bearer values, recursively (:44-112). The webhook URL is scrubbed from exception messages with `str_replace($url, '[redacted]', $e->getMessage())` (:28), and the non-2xx log includes only the status. Only the message is logged, not the exception object or trace, so the URL cannot leak through the context. Small residual risk: the scrub only matches the exact URL string, so an exception message containing a URL-encoded or otherwise normalized form of the URL would get through.

tests.evidence: The diff adds no Pest/PHPUnit tests. Nothing covers the no-op when unconfigured, the payload format, the 1800-char truncation, redaction, soft-fail logging, URL scrubbing, or the logging config contract. The only change in phpunit.xml is the LOG_STACK env pin.

simplicity.evidence: A lean single class that uses the Http and Log facades directly. Some duplication: the sensitive-key and Bearer checks are repeated in formatValue (:47-53) and redactArray (:90-100), where formatValue could have delegated to one shared per-value redactor.

readability.evidence: Small, well-named private methods (buildText, formatValue, isSensitiveKey, redactArray) and clear control flow. Minor points: `mixed $key` is cast immediately (:45-47), the redaction pattern string is duplicated, and the public API has no docblock.

scope.evidence: Every file serves the task: .env.example, CHANGELOG.md, app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php, config/logging.php, config/services.php, docs/ops/logging.md, phpunit.xml. The notifier is not wired into any job or handler (out of scope), and there are no unrelated edits.

issues.explanation: No tests ship with the new notifier or the logging config, which violates the project's mandatory test-first rule and leaves redaction, truncation, no-op and soft-fail behavior unverified.
Text building runs outside the try block, so a context value that is a non-stringable object makes `(string) $value` throw an Error into the caller, which breaks the 'must never throw' requirement.
`(string) json_encode($redacted)` turns an encoding failure (e.g. invalid UTF-8) into an empty string with no fallback, such as JSON_INVALID_UTF8_SUBSTITUTE or JSON_PARTIAL_OUTPUT_ON_ERROR.
The sensitive-key and Bearer redaction checks are duplicated between formatValue and redactArray instead of sharing one per-value redaction helper.
The new public method `send` has no PHPDoc, which the docs-in-sync convention asks for.
The file has no trailing newline.

review.summary: The change adds a Discord ops notifier with key/Bearer redaction, 1800-char truncation, a silent no-op when unconfigured, and soft-fail logging with the URL scrubbed. It also adds the audit channel, switches the stack default to daily, pins LOG_STACK in phpunit.xml and documents the three lanes. The implementation is close to the contract and well scoped, but it ships with no tests at all, which violates the project's mandatory TDD convention. Context formatting can also still throw outside the try block, so it needs changes before merging.
